Problem: Same clonal families in different alpacas (Sets: {S1, S2, S3,…,S12})

Excel file (`Copy of S19-Consensus-CDR3-Query-Comparisons27Feb24`) indices: [70 vs. 72], [133 vs. 135], [280 vs. 282]

Are the DNA sequences very similar, or are the genes very similar?

How does their sequence alignment look together and separately?

#### Imports

```{r}
library(tableone)
library(msa)

source("~/VHH/lib/utilities.R")

# Translate DNA
translate_DNA <- function(dna_data){
  clean_dna <- gsub("[^ACTG]", "", dna_data)
  DNA_strings <- Biostrings::DNAStringSet(clean_dna)
  translations <- as.character(Biostrings::translate(DNA_strings))
  return(translations)
}

# Trim CDR3
trim_CDR3 <- function(seq_vec){
  return(substr(seq_vec, 2, nchar(seq_vec)-1))
}

top_groups <- function(results, clone_var){
  return(table(results[[clone_var]])[order(table(results[[clone_var]]), decreasing = T)])
}

## ###
## New Functions
## ###

rollout_dupes <- function(pass){
  dedup_pass <- data.frame()
  for (i in 1:nrow(pass)){
    for (j in 1:pass$duplicate_count[i]){
      dedup_pass <- rbind(dedup_pass, pass[i,])
    }
  }
  return(dedup_pass)
}

pull_all_clones <- function(df, cdr_seq, deduplicate = TRUE){
  tmp <- df[df$junction_aa == cdr_seq,]
  tmp <- df[df$clone_id %in% as.numeric(names(table(tmp$clone_id))),]
  #if (deduplicate){
  # print(nrow(tmp))
  tmp <- tmp[!duplicated(tmp$VHH),]
    #print(nrow(tmp))
  #} else {
    ## Unroll duplicates
    #tmp <- rollout_dupes(tmp[which(!grepl("\\*", tmp$VHH, fixed = F)),])
  #}
  return(tmp)
}

run_alignment <- function(dat){
  results <- data.frame()
  for (clone_id in unique(dat$clone_id)){
    # Cluster by clone id
    tmp_frame <- dat[dat$clone_id == clone_id,]
    sequences <- Biostrings::AAStringSet(tmp_frame$VHH)
    # Perform multiple sequence alignment
    msa_result <- msa::msa(sequences, method = "ClustalOmega", verbose = T, order = "input")
    # Store aligned results
    tmp_frame$Aligned_VHHs <- as.character(msa_result@unmasked)
    results <- rbind(results, tmp_frame)
  }
  return(results)
}

write_results <- function(dat, file_folder, consensus_seq, columns){
  tmp <- dat[,columns]
  write.csv(tmp, file = paste(file_folder, consensus_seq, "-clone-alignment02Mar24.csv", sep = ''), row.names = F)
}

plotDat <- function(dat, column, x_col, bs, mn, xl, yl){
  tmp <- as.matrix(table(dat[[column]], dat[[x_col]]))
  prop <- prop.table(tmp, margin = 2)#2 for column-wise proportions
  par(mar = c(5.0, 4.0, 4.0, 15), xpd = TRUE)
  barplot(prop, col = cm.colors(length(rownames(prop))), beside = bs, width = 2, main = mn, xlab = xl, ylab = yl)
  legend("topright", inset = c(-0.90,0), fill = cm.colors(length(rownames(prop))), legend=rownames(prop))
}
```

  tmp$cdr1_length <- nchar(tmp$cdr1)
  tmp$cdr2_length <- nchar(tmp$cdr2)
  tmp$cdr3_length <- nchar(tmp$cdr3)

  tmp$fwr3_length <- nchar(tmp$fwr3)
  tmp$fwr4_length <- nchar(tmp$fwr4)

}

## Perform MSA and compute consensus sequence for both Mikka and Marvel

```{r}
align_VHHs <- function(df){
  results <- data.frame()
  for (nm in unique(df$study_id)){
    tmp_frame <- df[df$study_id == nm,]
    sequences <- Biostrings::AAStringSet(tmp_frame$VHH)
    # Perform multiple sequence alignment
    msa_result <- msa::msa(sequences, method = "ClustalOmega", verbose = T, order = "input")
    # Store aligned results
    tmp_frame$Aligned_VHHs <- as.character(msa_result@unmasked)
    results <- rbind(results, tmp_frame)
  }
  return(results)
}
```

```{r}
tmp <- align_VHHs(tmp)

tmp$Aligned_VHHs <- gsub("-", ' ', tmp$Aligned_VHHs)
```

```{r}
write.csv(tmp[ ,c("sequence_id", "study_id", "clone_id", "Aligned_VHHs")], file = "~/Downloads/S7-S9-KRTYIGRDY-Contamination-Check-Alignments.csv", row.names = F)
```

```{r}
align_VHHs <- function(df){
  results <- data.frame()
  for (nm in unique(df$study_id)){
    tmp_frame <- df[df$study_id == nm,]
    sequences <- Biostrings::AAStringSet(tmp_frame$VHH)
    # Perform multiple sequence alignment
    msa_result <- msa::msa(sequences, method = "ClustalOmega", verbose = T, order = "input")
    # Store aligned results
    tmp_frame$Aligned_VHHs <- as.character(msa_result@unmasked)
    results <- rbind(results, tmp_frame)
  }
  return(results)
}
```
